scope: Q4 no depth4 bonus future alternative; current full333 unchanged
interpretation: Historical visible bonuses are about11% of output. Simply removing them at unchanged cost cannot improve Raw. A pruned Q4 design needs enough measured cycle-cost reduction to offset lost output; fewer nominal query rows alone do not prove a speedup.
limitations: This is not a rerun or an end-to-end counterfactual: future prefixes, B decisions and tails would change.
128/160 linear cost is an illustrative assumption, not measured performance.
Original all-query tree ABI cannot represent missing leaf heads; a new typed query map, verifier and KV frontier contract would be needed.
Fresh numeric and complete own-AR gates remain mandatory.
